capabilities: Render inline icons and labels for web, app, and internal links
Cache website favicons and page titles for bare URLs
Import custom site icons from files or image URLs
Adjust link appearance, colors, and per-app icon sizes
Copy link destinations or Markdown links via commands
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Remote metadata fetching is on by default but avoids opening one-time or account-changing URLs; detailed design and testing docs live outside the README. App icons require the destination app's URI handler on the device.
problem: Bare URLs and raw Markdown links in notes are hard to scan and don't show what site or app they point to.

relations.evidence: link mentions inspired by Notion and Codex

requires.name: destination apps for app:// deep links

summary: Link decoration plugin that renders inline icons and readable labels for web URLs, app deep links, and internal Obsidian links.
